payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate m from 1 to 1000, using precomputed sieve to check if n*m+1 is composite, output first composite case.
payload.rationale: The solution brute-force searches the small m range linearly. No graph traversal, backtracking, bitmask, branch-and-bound, or permutation enumeration is used. search_dfs_bfs_graph is selected as the least mismatched candidate by default, but nearly all subtypes are ill-fitting.
